headline_hint: Water and debris flood hydroelectric tunnel in Chamoli, killing several workers

raw_model_output.headline: Flooded Tunnel in Chamoli Kills Six Hydroelectric Project Workers
raw_model_output.body:
At least six workers died and 14 were injured when water and debris flooded an under-construction hydroelectric tunnel in Pipalkoti, Chamoli [c74]. The flooded tunnel in Chamoli is a 2km-long Tail Race Tunnel constructed by Hindustan Construction Company for THDC [c75].

The industrial accident occurred shortly after severe water surges in the region. A Bailey Bridge at Tamak Nala in Chamoli was swept away by surging water on August 10 [c76].
